p: words of Laban's sons: The children put in words what the father disguised in his heart for the covetous think that whatever they cannot take, is taken from them.
God of my father hath been: The God whom my fathers worshipped.
God hath taken away the cattle: This declares that the thing Jacob did before, was by God's commandment, and not through deceit.
I am the God of Bethel: This angel was Christ who appeared to Jacob in Bethel: and by this it appears that he had taught his wives the fear of God: for he talks as though they knew this thing.
sold us: For they were given to Jacob as payment for his service, which was a kind of sale.
images that were her father's: For so the word here signifies, because Laban calls them gods, Ge 31:30.
God of your father spake unto: He was an idolater and therefore would not acknowledge the God of Jacob for his God.
fear of Isaac: That is, the God whom Isaac feared and reverenced.
come thou: His conscience reproved him for his misbehaviour toward Jacob, and therefore moved him to seek peace.
Galeed: The one named the place in the Syrian tongue, and the other in the Hebrew tongue.
watch between me and thee: To punish the trespasser.
wives beside my daughters: Nature compels him to condemn that vice, to which through covetousness he forced Jacob.
Nahor: Behold, how the idolaters mingle the true God with their false gods.
fear of his father Isaac: Meaning, by the true God whom Isaac worshipped.
blessed them: We see that there is always some seed of the knowledge of God in the hearts of the wicked.
